To plot Feature importance of any model in Python, you can use the following code:

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Assuming 'model' is your trained model
feature_importance = model.feature_importances_

sorted_idx = np.argsort(feature_importance)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
plt.barh(range(len(sorted_idx)), feature_importance[sorted_idx], align='center')
plt.yticks(range(len(sorted_idx)), np.array(feature_names)[sorted_idx])
plt.xlabel('Feature Importance')
plt.title('Feature Importance of Model')
plt.show()
```

This code will plot a horizontal bar chart showing the importance of each feature in your model.
